invariants.rationale: The method requires a non-null StorageConfiguration instance to create the metadata writer.
A valid HoodieWriteConfig is needed to configure the writer and cannot be null.
The engine context is required to create the writer and must be non-null.
Option<String> should be non-null; the method may use None/empty Option to indicate absence, but Option itself should be a valid object.
Option.isPresent() is always true or false; included for completeness with Option semantics.
